# Pliego stock cards

Byte-identical copies of `materials/<slug>/stock.json` from
[madfam-org/pliego](https://github.com/madfam-org/pliego) `4b3fbfe` (main, kernel 0.2.0);
`cardstock-250` and `washi-kozo-30` are unchanged at `6b6243a`. `corrugated-b-flute` comes from
`6b6243a` (main) and carries the board `construction` block (pliego#8). Each card
states its own licence (`provenance.license`: CERN-OHL-W-2.0). They are test inputs for the
vendored `stock-card` contract. Refresh them from Pliego; do not edit them here.
